sections.content: HTML5 added native interactivity: <details>/<summary> for expandable sections, <dialog> for modals, <progress> and <meter> for gauges.
These elements work without JavaScript for basic cases — progressive enhancement means functionality exists even if scripts fail.
Key points: details/summary needs no JS for accordions, dialog needs showModal() for true modals, and meter vs progress differ (scalar vs completion).
